decisions.reason: Car transporter trailers still fit the firm's trailer know-how and customer base well, although their more specialized niche keeps the withdrawal risk above that of the broadest-volume lines.
Low-bed trailers support the firm's core promise of reliable solutions for varied hauling tasks and are a sensible part of a medium-sized German trailer maker's range.
High trailer covers complement multiple trailer models and support cross-selling, even if accessory-type product lines are somewhat easier to trim than complete vehicle lines.
After the earlier portfolio cleanup, this remaining box car trailer series appears to be the firm's relevant enclosed trailer line and fits its core market and distribution network well.
